title: Authored DSA 5 rule
description: One machine-checkable shape for an authored rule file under specs/rules/. Carries mechanical encoding plus provenance and no rule text (Data Policy, AGENTS.md). This schema is the contract the combat engine (ADR-0008) consumes.

type.description: The closed eight-case effect union (ADR-0008). Unhandled cases are a compile error in the engine rather than a silent no-op, so this enum is non-negotiable.

tier.description: The ability's Stufe (I-III), where the effect scales per tier (e.g. a shiftSteps parameterOverride multiplies by tier).

when.description: Preconditions, ANDed together. The closed ten-predicate set (ADR-0008); a novel condition costs an enum case, not a new string.

stacks.description: Explicit opt-out of the default rule that effects from different abilities stack (ADR-0008). Omit (or true) to stack normally; false marks an effect as participating in a 'strongest applies' exception that must otherwise be stated in the data (e.g. two `set` overrides of the same parameter).

value.description: modifier: the flat numeric modifier applied to the hero's own check (AT/PA/AW/FK/probe, ...).

parameter.description: parameterOverride: dotted path of the named DSA constant being overridden, e.g. `defense.multiplePenaltyPerStep`, `reach.matrix`, or a wildcard family such as `zone.*`.

set.description: parameterOverride: replace the named parameter's value outright (e.g. Meisterparade: set defense.multiplePenaltyPerStep = -2).

shiftSteps.description: parameterOverride: shift the named parameter by this many steps, scaled by the effect's `tier` (e.g. Unterlaufen: shiftSteps reach.matrix by tier).

scale.description: parameterOverride: multiply the named parameter by this factor (e.g. Gezielter Angriff: scale zone.* by 0.5).

add.description: dice: a damage/value expression to add, evaluated against the check context (e.g. "2 + ceil(self.gs / 2)", "1W6"). Free-form because the corpus's dice formulas are not closed the way effect types and predicates are.

grants.description: actionEconomy: what the ability grants or changes about action economy (e.g. "freeAction", "extraManeuver"). Free-form: ADR-0008 closes effect types and predicates, not this vocabulary.

skill.description: probe: which skill/check the probe is made against, when it is not simply the acting check (e.g. "Selbstbeherrschung").

state.description: stateGain: the Zustand/Status id granted (StateCatalog id), e.g. "betaeubung".

level.description: stateGain: the level granted, for leveled Zustände (I-IV).

action.description: legality: the otherwise-illegal action this effect makes legal, e.g. "basismanoever+spezialmanoever". Optional — some legality grants need no further qualification.
